title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I hope this find you in good health. I had a question about the interpretation of two dreams. I have been doing an Istekhara for a guy whom i would like to marry, but if the answer is negative, May Allah give me the strength to accept it and stay away from anything which is not good for me. In the first dream, There are two groups of people on two pedestals, and the one with the guy is higher, because im looking up at him. One group was wearing black and the other was wearing green, but i dont remember who was wearing what color. In the next dream, my friend and i am sitting in the doctor's office, and this guy comes and asks if he can talk to me, and my friends says no twice, then my friend gets up to talk to the doctor and i say ok i will talk to you, then my friend turns around and tells me she will be having a girl, and i am extremely happy, and me and this guy walk outside, where the sun is very bright. 2240 views Q. I want to know if she marries in this condition, will it be legal and lawful as her parents emotionally blackmailed her? What alternate way is there so that she can convey her wish to their parents? If she marries, I won?t marry anyone ever. As I have accepted her as my wife keeping Allah as witness. Please help. I?ll be very grateful to you. Thank you. 2975 views Q. I am a 20 yo girl engaged to a 25y person, and we planned to get married on july, he came 4 that, but my parents refuse now because he is not very rich, they want a huge muhr, and huge wedding... can i get married to him without their permission? 3334 views Q. Janab Assalam-mualayikum, Hum ek kafi bade masale me fhase hue hai, Humne apki Nikkad kitab (english version) padhi hai, Usme Line no.18 per jo masala bayan kar rakha hai, usse talluq rakhta hai. Humne wohi masala Shahi-Bukhari me bhi padha. Janab, hum pichle kayee mahino se apni shadi ke talluq se fiqar ghuza the, or dil jaisi koi ladki nazar me nahi aa rahi thi. Tab achanak Humari Phupu ki ladki jo humari hum umr hain kisis tijarati fiqar se humare yahan rehne aayi. Uski aadatein, soch, taur-tariqee dekh kar woh hume pasand aane lagi, usme woh tammam sifatein hain jo hum apne jode me talsh kar rahe they, Hum apni yeh pasand apne walidaein ko pesh karnehi wale they ki Shahi-Bukahri ke supplement per nazar gayi. jo Line no. hum pehle bayan kar rakhe hain. Jo wakiya usme bayan hua hai, hum wahi galti apne umr ki 13 weh saal me kar baithein hai, Hum apne nafz ke hathon kaid ho rakhe thein or raat k waqt humne apni phupu ko galat intension se unke jism ko hath lagaya. Yeh galti 2-3 martaba ho chuki humse Is baat ko ab 13 saal ho chuke hain, Ab bataur Allah Hukum, hum unki ladki se nikaah nahi kar sakte, Per hume woh ladki kafi pasand hai, Kya is galti ki koi iscilah nahi ho sakti, taki hum usse nikah kar sakein. Batur-ehsaan hum guzarish karte hain ke hume jaldi jawab mile, usse kuch ladkewale dekh ne aane wale hai agle budh ko, hum usse pehle apni khwahish apne walidein ke samne rakhna chahte hai. Ap ke jawab ka badi be-sabri se intezar kiya jaye ga. Dua- ke darkhwast Allah Hafiz! 7277 views Q. Changing madhhab after marriage 3637 views Q. I know and love a woman who has a married son. i want to marry her but she afraid of her son and daughter in law. can we marry without telling anyone or kindly suggest some procedure. 2507 views

Answer ID: 857 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 446/434=N) In this situation, you should marry him and inform your family later and get them satisfied. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
